reason: RETIRED: the one-core refactor (R0–R6) landed as feat/one-core in both repos, so the four door files no longer need freezing. `paths` is empty on purpose — an empty list means no lock. howToEdit: To lock again, list the files in `paths` (a path ending in / locks a whole folder). A `paths` array that is empty, or no file at all, means no lock.
